from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display


def file_data_uri(path, media_type):
    """Embed a local file as a data URI so clicking downloads it directly."""
    path = Path(path)
    if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
        return None
    encoded = base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
    return f"data:{media_type};base64,{encoded}"

summary_file = Path(summary_file)
coverage_file = Path(coverage_file)
blast_file = Path(blast_file)
genoflu_file = Path(genoflu_file) if genoflu_file else None
vadr_log_file = Path(vadr_log_file) if vadr_log_file else None

summary = pd.read_csv(
    summary_file,
    sep="\t",
    keep_default_na=False,
)

coverage = pd.read_csv(
    coverage_file,
    sep="\t",
    keep_default_na=False,
)

blast = pd.read_csv(
    blast_file,
    keep_default_na=False,
)

if summary.empty:
    raise ValueError(f"Summary table is empty: {summary_file}")

row = summary.iloc[0]

def display_unknown(value):
    """Use Unknown for missing analytical calls without renaming the NA segment."""
    text = str(value).strip()
    if not text or text.upper() in {"NA", "N/A", "NONE", "NO_HIT", "UNDETERMINED"}:
        return "Unknown"
    return text

review_flags = str(row["review_flags"])

if review_flags == "NONE":
    review_text = "No review flags"
    review_status = "status-pass"
else:
    review_text = review_flags.replace(";", ", ")
    review_status = "status-warning"

h5n1_status = str(row["h5n1_screen"]).upper()
h5n1_badge = "PASS" if h5n1_status == "PASS" else "WARNING"
h5n1_class = "status-pass" if h5n1_badge == "PASS" else "status-warning"

segments_pass = int(row["segments_pass"])
segment_class = (
    "status-pass"
    if segments_pass == 8
    else "status-warning"
)

reads_after = int(row["reads_after"])

## Segment coverage

```{python}
segment_order = ["PB2", "PB1", "PA", "HA", "NP", "NA", "MP", "NS"]
expected_lengths = {
    "PB2": (2200, 2400), "PB1": (2200, 2400), "PA": (2100, 2300),
    "HA": (1600, 1800), "NP": (1450, 1600), "NA": (1300, 1500),
    "MP": (950, 1050), "NS": (800, 950),
}
segment_data = coverage.copy()
segment_data["segment"] = segment_data["segment"].astype(str)
segment_data["contig"] = segment_data["contig"].astype(str)
segment_data["coverage_status"] = segment_data["coverage_flag"].astype(str).str.upper()
for column in ["length", "median_depth", "mean_depth", "breadth_covered"]:
    segment_data[column] = pd.to_numeric(segment_data[column], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

def completeness_status(record):
    expected = expected_lengths.get(record["segment"])
    if not expected:
        return "REVIEW"
    return "PASS" if expected[0] <= float(record["length"]) <= expected[1] else "REVIEW"

segment_data["completeness_status"] = segment_data.apply(completeness_status, axis=1)
segment_data["overall_status"] = segment_data.apply(
    lambda r: "PASS" if r["coverage_status"] == "PASS" and r["completeness_status"] == "PASS"
    else ("WARNING" if r["coverage_status"] == "PASS" else "REVIEW"), axis=1
)
segment_data["expected_length_min"] = segment_data["segment"].map(lambda x: expected_lengths.get(x, (None, None))[0])
segment_data["expected_length_max"] = segment_data["segment"].map(lambda x: expected_lengths.get(x, (None, None))[1])
segment_data["sort"] = segment_data["segment"].map({s:i for i,s in enumerate(segment_order)})
segment_data = segment_data.sort_values("sort").drop(columns="sort")
segment_records = segment_data[[
    "segment", "contig", "length", "median_depth", "mean_depth", "breadth_covered",
    "coverage_status", "completeness_status", "overall_status",
    "expected_length_min", "expected_length_max"
]].to_dict(orient="records")
segment_payload = {"threshold": float(coverage_threshold), "segments": segment_records}
segment_json = json.dumps(segment_payload, ensure_ascii=False).replace("</", "<\\/")

display(HTML(f"""
<div class="escape-viz-card escape-segment-card">
  <div class="escape-viz-heading">
    <div>
      <div class="escape-viz-eyebrow">Influenza A genome QC</div>
      <div class="escape-viz-title">Interactive segment coverage</div>
      <div class="escape-viz-subtitle">Switch between median depth, completeness, and QC status. Select a segment for details.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="escape-viz-accent" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="escape-segment-viz" data-escape-segments='{html.escape(segment_json, quote=True)}'></div>
</div>
"""))
```

blast_display = blast.copy()
blast_display.columns = [
    "Sample",
    "Segment",
    "Top BLAST hit",

def ncbi_nuccore_link(accession):
    accession = str(accession).strip()

    if not accession or accession.upper() in {"NO_HIT", "NONE", "NA", "N/A"}:
        return html.escape(accession or "NO_HIT")

    url = (
        "https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore/"
        + quote(accession, safe="._-")
    )

    return (
        f'<a class="blast-accession-link" href="{url}" '
        'target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">'
        f'{html.escape(accession)}</a>'
    )


blast_display["Top BLAST hit"] = blast_display[
    "Top BLAST hit"
].map(ncbi_nuccore_link)

display(
    HTML(
        '<div class="report-panel">'
        + blast_display.to_html(
            index=False,
            escape=False,
            classes="report-table",

    )
)

## GenoFLU genotype

```{python}
def parse_genoflu_report(path):
    """Parse the compact plain-text GenoFLU report emitted by genoflu.py."""
    result = {
        "status": "Not available",
        "reason": "GenoFLU output was not provided to the report.",
        "threshold": None,
        "matched_segments": None,
        "input_segments": None,
        "calls": {},
        "raw_text": "",
    }

    if path is None or not path.exists() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
        return result

    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    result["raw_text"] = text

    threshold_match = re.search(r"pident_threshold:\s*([0-9.]+)", text)
    if threshold_match:
        result["threshold"] = float(threshold_match.group(1))

    summary_match = re.search(
        r"consensus\s+Genotype\s+-->\s+([^:\n]+):\s*(.*)",
        text,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    if summary_match:
        result["status"] = summary_match.group(1).strip()
        result["reason"] = summary_match.group(2).strip()

    count_match = re.search(
        r"Only\s+(\d+)\s+segments\s+>[0-9.]+%\s+match\s+found\s+of\s+total\s+(\d+)\s+segments",
        text,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    if count_match:
        result["matched_segments"] = int(count_match.group(1))
        result["input_segments"] = int(count_match.group(2))

    calls_match = re.search(
        r"segments\s+in\s+input\s+file:\s*(.*?)\s+at\s+percent\s+identity",
        text,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
    )
    if calls_match:
        for item in calls_match.group(1).split(","):
            if ":" not in item:
                continue
            segment, call = item.split(":", 1)
            segment = segment.strip().upper()
            call = call.strip()
            if segment and call:
                result["calls"][segment] = call

    return result


genoflu = parse_genoflu_report(genoflu_file)
all_segments = ["PB2", "PB1", "PA", "HA", "NP", "NA", "MP", "NS"]
call_rows = []

for segment in all_segments:
    call = genoflu["calls"].get(segment)
    call_rows.append(
        {
            "Segment": segment,
            "GenoFLU call": (
                html.escape(call)
                if call
                else '<span class="file-unavailable">Not available</span>'
            ),
        }
    )

calls_df = pd.DataFrame(call_rows)
status_text = str(genoflu["status"])
status_class = (
    "download-status-pass"
    if status_text.lower() not in {"not assigned", "not available"}
    else "download-status-review"
)

if genoflu_file and genoflu_file.exists() and genoflu_file.stat().st_size > 0:
    genoflu_href = file_data_uri(genoflu_file, "text/plain;charset=utf-8")
    genoflu_download = (
        f'<a class="file-download-link" href="{genoflu_href}" '
        f'download="{html.escape(str(sample_id))}_GenoFLU.tsv">'
        '<span aria-hidden="true">↓</span> GenoFLU output</a>'
    )
else:
    genoflu_download = '<span class="file-unavailable">Output not available</span>'

matched = genoflu["matched_segments"]
input_count = genoflu["input_segments"]
threshold = genoflu["threshold"]
missing_segments = [segment for segment in all_segments if segment not in genoflu["calls"]]

summary_bits = []
if matched is not None:
    if status_text.lower() == "not assigned" and missing_segments:
        missing_count = len(missing_segments)
        segment_word = "segment was" if missing_count == 1 else "segments were"
        summary_bits.append(
            f"{matched} segments matched; {missing_count} required genome {segment_word} unavailable"
        )
    elif input_count is not None:
        summary_bits.append(f"{matched} of {input_count} input segments matched")
    else:
        summary_bits.append(f"{matched} segments matched")
if threshold is not None:
    summary_bits.append(f"identity threshold: {threshold:g}%")
summary_line = " · ".join(summary_bits)

if status_text.lower() == "not assigned":
    submitted_count = input_count if input_count is not None else len(genoflu["calls"])
    matched_count = matched if matched is not None else len(genoflu["calls"])
    threshold_phrase = f" at ≥{threshold:g}% identity" if threshold is not None else ""
    missing_text = ", ".join(missing_segments) if missing_segments else "one or more required segments"
    result_text = (
        f"All {matched_count} of {submitted_count} submitted segments matched{threshold_phrase}, "
        f"but {missing_text} were unavailable, so a complete eight-segment genotype "
        "could not be assigned."
    )
    interpretation_text = (
        "GenoFLU completed successfully. Missing or unresolved segments are shown as "
        "not available."
    )
else:
    result_text = str(genoflu["reason"])
    interpretation_text = "GenoFLU completed and returned the genotype result shown below."

reason_text = html.escape(result_text)

genoflu_html = (
    '<div class="report-panel">'
    '<div class="file-download-header">'
    '<div>'
    '<div class="file-download-title">Genotype assignment</div>'
    f'<div class="file-download-subtitle">{html.escape(summary_line)}</div>'
    '</div>'
    f'<div><span class="download-status {status_class}">{html.escape(status_text)}</span></div>'
    '</div>'
    f'<p><strong>GenoFLU result:</strong> {reason_text}</p>'
    '<div class="file-download-table-wrap">'
    + calls_df.to_html(
        index=False,
        escape=False,
        classes="report-table genoflu-table",
    )
    + '</div>'
    '<div class="file-download-header" style="margin-top: 1rem;">'
    f'<div class="file-download-note">{html.escape(interpretation_text)}</div>'
    f'<div>{genoflu_download}</div>'
    '</div>'
    '</div>'
)

display(HTML(genoflu_html))
```


## VADR annotation quality control

```{python}
def parse_vadr_log(path):
    """Parse key sequence and alert summaries from a VADR v-annotate.pl log."""
    result = {
        "available": False,
        "completed": False,
        "version": None,
        "sequence_count": 0,
        "pass_count": 0,
        "fail_count": 0,
        "segments": [],
        "alerts": [],
    }

    if path is None or not path.exists() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
        return result

    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    result["available"] = True
    result["completed"] = bool(re.search(r"^\[ok\]\s*$", text, flags=re.MULTILINE))

    version_match = re.search(r"# VADR\s+([^\s]+)", text)
    if version_match:
        result["version"] = version_match.group(1)

    segment_map = {
        "fluA-seg1": "PB2",
        "fluA-seg2": "PB1",
        "fluA-seg3": "PA",
        "fluA-seg4": "HA",
        "fluA-seg5": "NP",
        "fluA-seg6": "NA",
        "fluA-seg7": "MP",
        "fluA-seg8": "NS",
    }

    model_pattern = re.compile(
        r"^\s*\d+\s+(\S+)\s+(fluA-seg\d+)\s+(\S+)\s+"
        r"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*$",
        flags=re.MULTILINE,
    )
    for model, group, subgroup, nseq, npass, nfail in model_pattern.findall(text):
        result["segments"].append(
            {
                "Segment": segment_map.get(group, group),
                "Model": (
                    f'<a href="https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore/{html.escape(model)}" '
                    f'target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">{html.escape(model)}</a>'
                ),
                "Subtype/group": "—" if subgroup == "-" else subgroup,
                "VADR status": "PASS" if int(nfail) == 0 else "REVIEW",
            }
        )
        result["sequence_count"] += int(nseq)
        result["pass_count"] += int(npass)
        result["fail_count"] += int(nfail)

    alert_pattern = re.compile(
        r"^\s*\d+\s+(\S+)\s+(yes\*?|no)\s+(\S+)\s+\S+\s+"
        r"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(.+?)\s*$",
        flags=re.MULTILINE,
    )
    for code, causes_failure, short, cases, seqs, description in alert_pattern.findall(text):
        result["alerts"].append(
            {
                "Alert": code,
                "Effect": short.replace("_", " ").title(),
                "Failure-causing": "Yes" if causes_failure.startswith("yes") else "No",
                "Cases": int(cases),
                "Sequences": int(seqs),
            }
        )

    return result


vadr = parse_vadr_log(vadr_log_file)

if not vadr["available"]:
    display(
        HTML(
            '<div class="report-panel">'
            '<div class="file-download-title">VADR annotation</div>'
            '<p class="file-download-note">VADR output was not available to this report.</p>'
            '</div>'
        )
    )
else:
    vadr_status = "PASS" if vadr["completed"] else "REVIEW"
    vadr_status_class = "download-status-pass" if vadr["completed"] else "download-status-review"

    segment_df = pd.DataFrame(vadr["segments"])
    if not segment_df.empty:
        segment_df["VADR status"] = segment_df["VADR status"].map(
            lambda value: (
                f'<span class="status-pill {"status-pass" if value == "PASS" else "status-warning"}">'
                f'{html.escape(value)}</span>'
            )
        )
        segment_table = segment_df.to_html(
            index=False,
            escape=False,
            classes="report-table vadr-segment-table",
        )
    else:
        segment_table = '<p class="file-download-note">No per-segment VADR rows were parsed.</p>'

    alerts_df = pd.DataFrame(vadr["alerts"])
    failure_alerts = alerts_df[alerts_df["Failure-causing"] == "Yes"] if not alerts_df.empty else alerts_df
    if not failure_alerts.empty:
        alerts_table = failure_alerts.to_html(
            index=False,
            escape=True,
            classes="report-table vadr-alert-table",
        )
    else:
        alerts_table = '<p class="file-download-note">No failure-causing VADR alerts were reported.</p>'

    vadr_href = file_data_uri(vadr_log_file, "text/plain;charset=utf-8")
    vadr_download = (
        f'<a class="file-download-link" href="{vadr_href}" '
        f'download="{html.escape(str(sample_id))}_VADR.log">'
        '<span aria-hidden="true">↓</span> VADR log</a>'
        if vadr_href
        else '<span class="file-unavailable">Log not available</span>'
    )

    version_text = f' · VADR {html.escape(vadr["version"])}' if vadr["version"] else ""
    interpretation = (
        f'VADR completed on {vadr["sequence_count"]} coverage-qualified consensus sequences: '
        f'{vadr["pass_count"]} passed annotation checks and {vadr["fail_count"]} failed. '
        'A sequence-level VADR failure is a quality-control finding and does not mean the pipeline failed.'
    )

    vadr_html = (
        '<div class="report-panel">'
        '<div class="file-download-header">'
        '<div>'
        '<div class="file-download-title">VADR annotation quality control</div>'
        f'<div class="file-download-subtitle">{vadr["pass_count"]} pass · '
        f'{vadr["fail_count"]} fail · {vadr["sequence_count"]} analyzed{version_text}</div>'
        '</div>'
        f'<div><span class="download-status {vadr_status_class}">{vadr_status}</span></div>'
        '</div>'
        f'<p>{html.escape(interpretation)}</p>'
        '<div class="file-download-table-wrap">'
        f'{segment_table}'
        '</div>'
        '<div class="file-download-title" style="margin-top: 1rem;">Failure-causing alerts</div>'
        '<div class="file-download-table-wrap">'
        f'{alerts_table}'
        '</div>'
        '<div class="file-download-header" style="margin-top: 1rem;">'
        '<div class="file-download-note">Review failed segments and alerts before downstream submission or interpretation.</div>'
        f'<div>{vadr_download}</div>'
        '</div>'
        '</div>'
    )
    display(HTML(vadr_html))
```

## Consensus and variant files

```{python}
def count_vcf_records(path):
    """Count non-header variant records in a valid, non-empty VCF."""
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        return sum(
            1
            for line in handle
            if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#")
        )

segment_download_rows = []
report_dir = summary_file.parent
sample_dir = report_dir.parent

for _, segment_row in segment_data.iterrows():
    segment = str(segment_row["segment"])
    consensus_path = sample_dir / "medaka" / segment / "consensus.fasta"
    vcf_path = sample_dir / "medaka" / segment / "variants.vcf"

    consensus_available = consensus_path.exists() and consensus_path.stat().st_size > 0
    vcf_available = vcf_path.exists() and vcf_path.stat().st_size > 0

    if consensus_available:
        consensus_href = file_data_uri(consensus_path, "text/plain;charset=utf-8")
        consensus_link = (
            f'<a class="file-download-link" href="{consensus_href}" '
            f'download="{html.escape(str(sample_id))}_{html.escape(segment)}_consensus.fasta">'
            '<span aria-hidden="true">↓</span> FASTA</a>'
        )
    else:
        consensus_link = '<span class="file-unavailable">Not available</span>'

    coverage_status = str(segment_row["coverage_status"]).upper()

    if vcf_available:
        variant_count = count_vcf_records(vcf_path)
        variant_label = "1 variant" if variant_count == 1 else f"{variant_count} variants"
        variant_summary = (
            '<span class="download-status download-status-pass">'
            f'{variant_label}</span>'
        )
        vcf_href = file_data_uri(vcf_path, "text/plain;charset=utf-8")
        vcf_link = (
            f'<a class="file-download-link" href="{vcf_href}" '
            f'download="{html.escape(str(sample_id))}_{html.escape(segment)}_variants.vcf">'
            '<span aria-hidden="true">↓</span> VCF</a>'
        )
    elif coverage_status != "PASS":
        variant_summary = (
            '<span class="download-status download-status-fail">'
            'Skipped: coverage</span>'
        )
        vcf_link = '<span class="file-unavailable">Not generated</span>'
    else:
        variant_summary = (
            '<span class="download-status download-status-review">'
            'No VCF produced</span>'
        )
        vcf_link = '<span class="file-unavailable">Not generated</span>'

    status = str(segment_row["overall_status"])
    status_class = {
        "PASS": "download-status-pass",
        "REVIEW": "download-status-review",
        "FAIL": "download-status-fail",
    }.get(status, "download-status-neutral")

    segment_download_rows.append(
        {
            "Segment": html.escape(segment),
            "Consensus length": f'{int(segment_row["length"]):,} nt',
            "QC status": (
                f'<span class="download-status {status_class}">'
                f'{html.escape(status)}</span>'
            ),
            "Consensus": consensus_link,
            "Variant calls": variant_summary,
            "VCF": vcf_link,
        }
    )

segment_downloads = pd.DataFrame(segment_download_rows)
merged_consensus = sample_dir / "merged" / "consensus_all_segments.fasta"
merged_available = merged_consensus.exists() and merged_consensus.stat().st_size > 0

if merged_available:
    merged_href = file_data_uri(merged_consensus, "text/plain;charset=utf-8")
    merged_link = (
        '<a class="file-download-link file-download-primary" '
        f'href="{merged_href}" '
        f'download="{html.escape(str(sample_id))}_consensus_all_segments.fasta">'
        '<span aria-hidden="true">↓</span> Download combined consensus FASTA</a>'
    )
else:
    merged_link = '<span class="file-unavailable">Combined consensus FASTA not available</span>'

files_html = (
    '<div class="report-panel file-download-panel">'
    '<div class="file-download-header">'
    '<div>'
    '<div class="file-download-title">Analysis-ready sequence files</div>'
    '<div class="file-download-subtitle">Files download directly from this self-contained report.</div>'
    '</div>'
    f'<div class="file-download-primary-wrap">{merged_link}</div>'
    '</div>'
    '<div class="file-download-table-wrap">'
    + segment_downloads.to_html(
        index=False,
        escape=False,
        classes="report-table file-download-table",
    )
    + '</div>'
    '<div class="file-download-note">'
    'Variant counts include non-header records in each valid VCF. A zero-variant VCF is valid and remains downloadable. '
    'Segments that fail coverage are reported as skipped rather than as having zero variants. '
    'Clicking a FASTA or VCF link downloads the file without opening a separate browser tab.'
    '</div>'
    '</div>'
)

display(HTML(files_html))
```


## Pipeline provenance

```{python}
def command_output(command, cwd=None):
    """Return the first non-empty line from a command, or None."""
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            command,
            cwd=cwd,
            check=True,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )
    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        return None

    output = (result.stdout or result.stderr).strip()
    return output.splitlines()[0] if output else None


resolved_summary = summary_file.resolve()
try:
    repo_root = resolved_summary.parents[3]
except IndexError:
    repo_root = Path.cwd().resolve()

config_path = repo_root / "config.yaml"
config_display = (
    str(config_path.relative_to(repo_root))
    if config_path.exists()
    else "Not captured"
)

git_commit = command_output(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "--short=12", "HEAD"],
    cwd=repo_root,
)
git_status = command_output(
    ["git", "status", "--porcelain"],
    cwd=repo_root,
)
if git_commit:
    workflow_revision = git_commit + (" (modified)" if git_status else "")
else:
    workflow_revision = "Not captured"

snakemake_version = os.environ.get("REPORT_SNAKEMAKE_VERSION") or command_output(["snakemake", "--version"])
quarto_version = command_output(["quarto", "--version"])

# Medaka runs in a separate rule-specific environment, so recover the version
# from the sample's Medaka logs rather than the reporting environment.
sample_dir = resolved_summary.parent.parent
medaka_version = None
for medaka_log in sorted((sample_dir / "medaka").glob("*/medaka_variant.log")):
    try:
        for line in medaka_log.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
            stripped = line.strip()
            if stripped.lower().startswith("medaka "):
                medaka_version = stripped.split(maxsplit=1)[1]
                break
    except OSError:
        continue
    if medaka_version:
        break

analysis_time = datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds")

provenance_rows = [
    ("Sample", str(sample_id)),
    ("Analysis completed", analysis_time),
    ("Workflow revision", workflow_revision),
    ("Configuration", config_display),
    ("Snakemake", snakemake_version or "Not captured"),
    ("Medaka", medaka_version or "Not captured"),
    ("Quarto", quarto_version or "Not captured"),
    ("Python", platform.python_version()),
    ("Coverage threshold", f"{float(coverage_threshold):g}x median depth"),
]

provenance_df = pd.DataFrame(
    provenance_rows,
    columns=["Item", "Value"],
)

length_rows = [
    {
        "Segment": segment,
        "Expected complete length": f"{minimum:,}–{maximum:,} nt",
    }
    for segment, (minimum, maximum) in expected_lengths.items()
]
length_df = pd.DataFrame(length_rows)

provenance_html = (
    '<div class="report-panel">'
    '<div class="file-download-title">Reproducibility record</div>'
    '<div class="file-download-subtitle">Versions and thresholds captured when this report was rendered.</div>'
    '<div class="file-download-table-wrap">'
    + provenance_df.to_html(
        index=False,
        escape=True,
        classes="report-table provenance-table",
    )
    + '</div>'
    '<div class="file-download-title" style="margin-top: 1.25rem;">Expected segment-length ranges</div>'
    '<div class="file-download-table-wrap">'
    + length_df.to_html(
        index=False,
        escape=True,
        classes="report-table provenance-table",
    )
    + '</div>'
    '<div class="file-download-note">'
    'A workflow revision marked “modified” indicates uncommitted repository changes at render time. '
    '“Not captured” means the executable or metadata was unavailable to the reporting environment.'
    '</div>'
    '</div>'
)

display(HTML(provenance_html))
```


## Interpretation

```{python}
interpretation = []

if int(row["segments_pass"]) == 8:
    interpretation.append(
        "All eight influenza A segments passed the "
        "configured coverage threshold."
    )
else:
    interpretation.append(
        f'{int(row["segments_pass"])} of 8 influenza A '
        "segments passed the configured coverage threshold."
    )

if row["h5n1_screen"] == "PASS":
    interpretation.append(
        "The sample met the pipeline's IRMA-supported "
        "H5N1 screening criterion."
    )
else:
    interpretation.append(
        "The sample did not meet the pipeline's "
        "H5N1 screening criterion."
    )

if str(row["failed_segment_names"]) != "NONE":
    failed = str(
        row["failed_segment_names"]
    ).replace(",", ", ")

    interpretation.append(
        f"Segments requiring review: {failed}."
    )

interpretation_html = "".join(
    f"<li>{item}</li>"
    for item in interpretation
)

display(
    HTML(
        f"""
        <div class="report-panel">
          <ul>
            {interpretation_html}
          </ul>
        </div>
        """
    )
)
```

> **Interpretation note:** The H5N1 result is an IRMA-supported analytical screening flag. It is not an independent confirmatory subtype test and should be interpreted with coverage, controls, sequence quality, and other samples from the sequencing run.
